ctx.x: And, did we talk about all the musicians that you remember from the San Francisco area? Uh, or were there more that you wanted to talk about when we got there?
Well, I knew, you know, quite a few musicians up there. There was Wesley Fields, the big piano player, and, oh, I can't think of...oh, George Bryant. I can't think of those guys' names now, you know.
